compress_mesh_indices: compress mesh indices from unsigned short to unsigned byte to reduce memory usage
concatenate_multiple_meshes: concatenate multiple meshes into a single mesh combining vertices and indices
generate_indices_from_strip: generate triangle indices from a triangle strip mesh primitive
filter_mesh_attributes: filter mesh attributes to keep only normals or exclude specific attributes
transform_mesh_positions_3d: transform 3D mesh positions using a 4x4 matrix for translation or rotation
